known_issues: Mini Pico can override scene URLs and keep its turn card; exact Pico firmware implementation unverified.
limits: Host mounts/sync mocked; QNX mounts mocked. No physical power-loss/storage durability proof.
Identical runtime bytes retain their earlier factory/J9 evidence; this release adds independently tested migration/packaging.
No new adapter firmware or custom unused-lane renderer is included.
